row_notes.reports: current reports of the crashes counted in the row
row_notes.crashes: unique incident_key, counted once in the program/month/file of its representative report
row_notes.fatal: crashes whose highest severity is fatal (SGO gives severity, not a death count)
row_notes.serious_plus: crashes with serious or fatal severity
row_notes.injury: crashes with any injury severity: minor, moderate, serious or fatal
row_notes.vru: crashes tagged vru (structured field or narrative keyword)
row_notes.vru_field: crashes tagged vru by a structured field only (comparable across redaction levels)
